now.title: Jessica Jones S1#10
now.text: Jeri Hogarth defends Hope Shlottman against a murder Kilgrave forced her to commit, then secretly frees Kilgrave hoping to use his power against her wife Wendy. The plan backfires, and he turns his control on Jeri and the people around her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The killer Jeri secretly frees to use against Wendy, who turns on her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The lawyer who frees Kilgrave, hoping to use him against her wife.

proposed.text: Jeri Hogarth defends Hope Shlottman against a murder Kilgrave forced her to commit, then secretly cuts the wires holding him in check, hoping to use his power against her wife Wendy. After he escapes, he takes control of Jeri and turns Wendy against her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The killer Jeri hopes to use against Wendy, who turns on her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The lawyer who sabotages Kilgrave's cell, hoping to use him against her wife.

changes.evidence: Jeri never frees Kilgrave. In Jessica Jones S1#9 (AKA Sin Bin) she cuts the wires that shock him and goes to open his cell door, but stops when she hears footsteps. He gets out in the chaos after his mother's death, and in S1#10 (AKA 1,000 Cuts) he finds Jeri at her car, controls her, and later sets Wendy on her.

now.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
now.text: The collider's destruction left Jonathan Ohnn covered in portals, and as the Spot he blames Miles for ruining his life and wants to be his great villain. He grows strong enough to threaten Miles's whole world.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A villain who blames Miles for ruining his life.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The nemesis the Spot blames for everything.

proposed.text: The collider's destruction left Johnathon Ohnn covered in portals, and as the Spot he blames Miles for ruining his life and wants to be his great villain. He grows strong enough to threaten Miles's whole world.

changes.evidence: The on-screen spelling is Johnathon Ohnn, which is also the name on this pair's own card. The text spells it Jonathan.

now.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
now.text: Anitolov pulls a gun on Hope van Dyne when Sonny Burch exposes her at his restaurant, and she fights her way through him and the rest of Burch's men in her Wasp suit.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fights through Anitolov and Burch's men at Burch's restaurant.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Burch henchman who pulls a gun on Hope.

proposed.text: When Sonny Burch exposes Hope van Dyne at his restaurant, Anitolov makes her sit for Burch's forced deal. When she comes back in her Wasp suit, he shoots at her, and she fights her way through him and the rest of Burch's men.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Burch henchman who shoots at Hope.

changes.evidence: At the Oui, when Burch reveals he knows who Hope is, Anitolov pulls out her seat to make her sit down. He shoots at her only later, once she attacks in the Wasp suit. No source has him pulling a gun on her when she is exposed.

now.title: Captain Marvel
now.text: Goose is Mar-Vell's pet Flerken and comes with her to Earth when she goes undercover as Dr. Wendy Lawson.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Owner who brings Goose to Earth when she goes undercover.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Mar-Vell's pet Flerken, who comes with her to Earth.

proposed.text: Goose is Mar-Vell's pet Flerken and lives with her on Earth while she works undercover as Dr. Wendy Lawson.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Goose's owner, who keeps her while working undercover on Earth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Mar-Vell's pet Flerken, who lives with her on Earth.

changes.evidence: Captain Marvel never shows Goose coming to Earth with Mar-Vell. The tie-in book Captain Marvel: Beware the Flerken! has Goose meeting Lawson on Earth. In the film Goose is simply Lawson's pet at Project Pegasus.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#16
now.text: Holden Radcliffe befriends Fitz, and the two secretly build the android Aida and the first new Life Model Decoys together. Radcliffe then turns on him, kidnapping Fitz and trapping his mind in the Framework, where Fitz becomes the cruel Doctor.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Radcliffe builds Aida with, then kidnaps and traps in the Framework.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Fitz builds Aida with, who then traps Fitz's mind in the Framework.

proposed.text: Holden Radcliffe befriends Fitz, and the two secretly build the android Aida, the first new Life Model Decoy. Radcliffe then betrays S.H.I.E.L.D., and his Framework becomes the trap that holds Fitz's mind, where Fitz becomes the cruel Doctor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The friend Radcliffe builds Aida with, later trapped in Radcliffe's Framework.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Fitz builds Aida with, whose Framework later traps Fitz's mind.

changes.evidence: Radcliffe does not kidnap Fitz. In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#14, Anton Ivanov's men capture Fitz at the Krasnoyarsk base, and Aida plugs him into the Framework. Radcliffe is already inside the Framework by then and is shocked when he learns Aida did it. Fitz helps build Aida, but not the other LMDs, such as May's, which Radcliffe and Aida make in secret.

owner_calls.question: Is the Tower of London detail on screen, with Betty and MJ tricking a drone into firing at a suit of armor? And should 'appears to save their Ferris wheel' credit Mysterio, when Night Monkey is the one who pulls Betty and Ned to safety?
options: Drop the armor detail and say Mysterio fights the Fire Elemental while Night Monkey saves the Ferris wheel
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's pages for Betty, MJ and the Battle of London say the group hides in the Jewel House vault, and MJ smashes a drone with a mace. None of them mention a suit of armor. In Prague, Betty calls for Night Monkey, and he rescues her and Ned from the wheel.
